rule: Set C v2 (Architect option 2, replaces the Peace-commit carve of M33): whole external repositories, held out from training. Pool: every repository in peaceai/model/ext-corpus.json whose root LICENSE classifies as its pinned SPDX id at its pinned commit. Order the pool by sha256('peaceai-ext-c:v1\n' + name) ascending; the first ceil(15% of the pool) repositories are set C. A set C repository contributes no file to any training stage; every file it has that passes the corpus file filters is held out by content sha256 across all sources. Not wired in as the evaluation set until the Architect decides; until then it is only excluded from training.
